mechanism.claim: Aggressive BTC flow has a strong UTC-slot baseline. A completed eight-hour net taker imbalance far from the strictly-prior median for the same slot is an innovation in directional urgency rather than ordinary intraday seasonality. During elevated BTC variation, follow a fresh upper-tail innovation for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of same-slot robust taker-imbalance innovation
mechanism.why_distinct: HVTIFP estimates lag-one dependence among 96 within-block imbalances. Daily flow acceleration compares adjacent full UTC days, while execution seasonality uses trade counts. HVTISI compares one completed aggregate taker imbalance only with prior values from its identical UTC slot, robustly scales by same-slot IQR, and uses no price direction, serial correlation, candle-sign volume, funding, OI, premium, cross-asset input, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed BTC eight-hour variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent while seasonally adjusted flow innovation magnitude enters its upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset same-slot robust flow-innovation onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact unique coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.net_flow: (2*sum taker_buy_quote-sum quote_asset_volume)/sum quote_asset_volume; finite strict nonzero, with finite nonnegative minute fields, taker<=quote, and quote sum strict positive
features.same_slot_history: at most 90 strictly prior source-valid net_flow values with the same decision UTC hour, minimum 60; current excluded
features.same_slot_center_scale: median and (q75-q25)/1.349 using numpy linear quantiles; IQR scale finite strict positive
features.innovation_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(flow_innovation) over at most 270 earlier source-valid innovations, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_returns: 95 close-to-close natural-log returns from 96 exact five-minute closes
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared btc_returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid predecessor cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all flow and price minutes complete
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent seasonally adjusted aggressive-flow innovation mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no slot, history, quantile, scale, innovation, rank, onset, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
